title: Weak Information Geometry: Riemannian Structures from Distributional Inference Functions and Stein Discrepancies
summary: The class of parametric statistical models that can be treated as Riemannian manifolds is considerably larger than the classical Fisher-Rao setting allows, once one works in the space of tempered distributions. A law is represented by a tempered distribution T in S'(R^k), while an instrument - a positive Schwartz kernel, a weak regular inference function, or a weak Stein representation - extracts information from the law without being part of it.
